manaNeeded: {4}{R/P}{R/P}{R/P}{R/P}{R/P}{R/P}, plus an additional {B} if Scion of the Ur-Dragon has summoning sickness
notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Scion of the Ur-Dragon.
description:
Activate Scion of the Ur-Dragon by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Scion of the Ur-Dragon a second time by paying {2}.
Resolve the first Scion of the Ur-Dragon ability, searching your library for Moltensteel Dragon, putting it into your graveyard, causing Scion of the Ur-Dragon to become a copy of Moltensteel Dragon until end of turn, and shuffling your library.
Activate Scion of the Ur-Dragon by paying {R/P}, giving itself +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 4 five additional times.
Resolve the Scion of the Ur-Dragon ability from step 1, searching your library for Skithiryx, putting it into your graveyard, causing Scion of the Ur-Dragon to become a copy of Skithiryx until end of turn, and shuffling your library.
If Scion of the Ur-Dragon has summoning sickness, activate it by paying {B}, giving it haste until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Scion of the Ur-Dragon, causing an opponent to get ten poison counters and lose the game due to lethal infect damage.
